title: Chapter 2: The Council with the Munchkins
chineseTitle: 第 2 章：与芒奇金人的会面

paragraphs.en: She was awakened by a shock, so sudden and severe that if Dorothy had not been lying on the soft bed she might have been hurt. As it was, the jar made her catch her breath and wonder what had happened; and Toto put his cold little nose into her face and whined piteously. Dorothy sat up and noticed that the house was not moving; nor was it dark, for the bright sunshine came in at the window, flooding the little room.
paragraphs.zh: 她被一声震动所唤醒，那是如此突然与剧烈，以至于如果多萝茜没有躺在软床上她可能会受伤。正因为如此，震动使她屏住了呼吸并好奇发生了什么；托托把它冰冷的小鼻子凑到她的脸上，可怜兮兮地呜咽着。多萝茜坐了起来，注意到房子没有在移动；也不是黑暗的，因为明亮的阳光从窗户透进来，淹没了小房间。

paragraphs.en: She leaped from her bed and with Toto at her heels ran and opened the door. The little girl gave a cry of amazement and looked about her, her eyes growing bigger and bigger at the wonderful sights she saw. The cyclone had set the house down very gently—for a cyclone—in the midst of a country of marvelous beauty. There were lovely patches of greensward all about, with stately trees bearing rich and luscious fruits. Banks of gorgeous flowers were on every hand, and birds with rare and brilliant plumage sang and fluttered in the bushes and trees.
paragraphs.zh: 她从床上跳了起来，托托跟在她脚后跟，跑去打开了门。小女孩发出一声惊呼环顾四周，她的双眼在她看到的奇妙景象下变得越来越大。龙卷风非常温柔地（对于龙卷风来说）把房子降落在一片有着惊人美丽的乡村中央。到处都是可爱的绿草地斑块，庄严的树木挂着丰富甘甜的水果。手边到处都是绚丽的花坛，带着罕见而鲜艳羽毛的鸟儿在灌木与树木里鸣唱盘旋。

paragraphs.en: While she stood looking eagerly at the strange and beautiful sights, she noticed coming toward her a group of the queerest people she had ever seen. They were not as tall as the grown people she had always been used to, but withal they were not very small. In fact, they seemed about as tall as Dorothy, who was a well-grown child for her age, although they were, so far as looks go, many years older.
paragraphs.zh: 当她站在那里急切地看着神奇而美丽的景象时，她注意到有一群她所见过的最古怪的人朝她走来。他们不如她一直习惯的大人那么高，但总的来说他们也不是非常微小。事实上，他们似乎和多萝茜差不多高（按她的年龄多萝茜是一个发育良好的孩子），尽管就长相而言他们要年长许多岁。

paragraphs.en: The Good Witch presented Dorothy with the magic Silver Shoes of the Wicked Witch of the East, who had been crushed under the house, and instructed her: 'Follow the Yellow Brick Road to the Emerald City, where the Great Wizard of Oz will help you return to Kansas.'
paragraphs.zh: 好女巫赠给多萝茜东方邪恶女巫（她已被压在房子下方）的魔法银鞋，并指示她：“沿着黄砖路前往翡翠城，在那里奥兹国伟大的魔术师会帮助你重返堪萨斯州。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow nodded thoughtfully, his painted face smiling. 'I cannot understand it,' he said. 'If your heads were stuffed with straw like mine, you would all live in the beautiful places and leave Kansas empty. But it is fortunate you have brains, for a brain is the only thing worth having in this world.'
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人深思地点头，画着的脸上笑着。'我无法理解它，'他说。'如果你们的头像我的一样塞满稻草，你们都会住在美丽的地方，把堪萨斯空出来。但幸运的是你们有脑子，因为脑子是世上唯一值得拥有的东西。'
